rows.text: when `edx` is below 0x1D (signed), reads dword `rcx+0x2C+edx*4` and calls `003340C0` + 0x19 with it; when that returns non-null, calls `003340C0` + 0x26 with the same dword and passes the result to `003340C0` + 0x2E, calls `003340C0` + 0x36 with the dword again and passes the result to `003340C0` + 0x3E, then stores the `eax` of `003340C0` + 0x45 (called with `ecx` = 0) into that dword; when either guard fails it returns without writing

notes: 003340C0: all callees are cited by site (+0x19, +0x26, +0x36 share one callee; +0x2E, +0x3E and +0x45 are three others). edx is sign-extended (movsxd) and the bound is jge, so negative edx passes the guard. No return value is stated. Doubt: low.
